title: VillagerTycoon
description: Manage your automated workforce: assign tasks to villagers using Lecterns, monitor their fitness, and restock their tools to keep production moving.
body:
# ⚙️ VillagerTycoon

**VillagerTycoon** revolutionizes the way villagers interact with your world. Say goodbye to passive trading boxes and hello to a fully automated, dynamic, and balanced workforce logistics system. 

By turning ordinary villagers into specialized laborers managed through **Lecterns**, this plugin brings a fresh tycoon-style management loop directly into Minecraft survival.

> 🌍 **Language Note:** In-game texts, commands, and roles are currently configured in **Italian**. Full English localization is planned for future updates!

---

## ⚙️ How It Works (Getting Started)

1. **Place a Station:** Place a **Lectern** (Leggio) with a valid profession/work block underneath or near it.
2. **Sign the Contract:** Put a standard **Paper** into an **Anvil** and rename it to the *exact custom name* you want to give your worker.
3. **Hire the Worker:** Perform a **Shift + Right-Click** on a Villager while holding your custom named paper to initialize the configuration and bind them to the system.
4. **Open the Registry:** Right-click the Lectern to access the custom GUI, equip your worker with tools, and start managing your production line!

---

## 💼 Available Jobs (Professions)
Depending on the work block assigned to the station, your hired worker will specialize in one of these 5 automated tasks (displayed in-game in Italian):

* **🌾 Farmer (Agricoltore):** Automatically tends to, harvests, and collects nearby crops.
* **⛏️ Miner (Minatore):** Mines underground resources and deposits ores.
* **🏹 Hunter (Cacciatore):** Hunts nearby passive or hostile mobs for meat, leather, and drops.
* **🎣 Fisherman (Pescatore):** Fishes in nearby water bodies to secure a steady supply of seafood and treasures.
* **🧪 Cleric (Chierico):** Handles magical resource processing and support tasks.

---

## ✨ Core Features

* **📖 Lectern-Based Management:** No complex commands for daily tasks. Everything is handled via an intuitive GUI inside a Lectern, serving as the worker's official registry.
* **🛠️ Tool Durability & Mechanics:** Workers don't magic items out of thin air. You must supply them with tools, and those tools will consume durability as they work. If an item breaks, production halts!
* **🔋 Fatigue & Stamina System:** Laborers get tired. Keep an eye on their fitness and manage their shifts—resting them is key to maintaining a highly productive empire.
* **🔭 Visual Workplace Boundaries:** Use the integrated Spyglass feature inside the GUI to visually project the exact operating boundaries of your worker's zone.

---

## 📖 In-Game Guide Book

Confused about stamina mechanics or tool wear? We've got you covered. Players can easily fetch an in-game instruction manual at any time using a simple command.

Feel free to run it in-game:
` /lavoratori guida `

> ⚠️ **Note:** If your inventory is completely full when running this command, the guide book will safely drop at your feet instead of vanishing!

---

## 🚀 Roadmap & Upcoming Features

We are just getting started! Here is what's planned for **v2.0**:
- [ ] Multi-language support (English localization config file).
- [ ] **The Perk Tree:** Unlock unique specializations, speed boosts, and efficiency upgrades for your veteran workers.
- [ ] New automated professions (Lumberjack and Armorer).
